title: The Trump administration still aims to make state citizenship lists ahead of midterms
content: The Trump administration is taking the unprecedented step of creating lists of adult citizens who are eligible to vote in each state – but will not meet its own deadline 60 days before Election Day.

title: Leon Black defies subpoena to testify in Epstein inquiry and sues House panel
content: The billionaire investor is under two subpoenas from the House Oversight Committee. But in his lawsuit, Black says the panel doesn't have the authority to compel him to share nondisclosure agreements.

title: Trump asks Supreme Court to lift block on USPS plan to restrict mail voting
content: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court to lift a temporary block on the U.S. Postal Service plan for President Trump's attempt to restrict mail-in voting for the midterm election.

title: Tributes to Gloria Steinem are flooding in, from Hollywood to Capitol Hill
content: Women in politics and pop culture are paying tribute to Gloria Steinem after her death at 92. Many called her not only an inspiration but a friend.

title: Later in life, Gloria Steinem found herself free of the 'demands of gender'
content: In 2015, the trailblazing feminist told Fresh Air she that had entered a new phase in life, one in which "you can do what you want." Steinem died Sept. 2 at the age of 92.

title: ICE officer faces federal charges for lying over shooting of Venezuelan immigrant
content: The charges represent a rare moment of the Justice Department seeking to hold immigration officers accountable.

title: Fox News abruptly parts ways with scandal-tarred star Maria Bartiromo
content: Fox News abruptly announced it had cut ties with anchor Maria Bartiromo after more than a dozen years.

title: Kissing apes, anti-splash urinals: This year's Ig Nobels showcase surprising science
content: The Ig Nobel Prizes were awarded this week for humorous yet thought-provoking research. This year, the ceremony came with a twist.

title: Dems demand DHS fund election security. And, journalist Gloria Steinem has died
content: Two Democrats are demanding that Homeland Security officials fund election security ahead of the midterms. And, trail-blazing journalist Gloria Steinem has died.

title: Gloria Steinem, trailblazing journalist and activist, dies at 92
content: At a time when women were largely limited to domestic roles, Steinem challenged gender stereotypes and championed feminist ideals like equality, sisterhood and reproductive freedom.
